description: Doc at TrustAnchor::from_cert says 'Prefer TrustAnchor::from when you need to keep cert alive'. This reads as 'use From by default', but from_cert (consuming) is the natural call when you own a cert from a trust store load and don't need it afterward — it avoids two unnecessary clones. The preference note should say 'use TrustAnchor::from(&cert) only if you need to use cert after this call', not imply borrow is generally preferred.
title: from_cert 'Prefer From' doc implies always borrow, but ownership is fine when cert not reused
